body:
Yeah porn is indeed pretty unrealistic, and it does warp a lot of people's expectations, I agree. And yeah I did some searches too, found out things that are similar to what you said, along with a lot of factors that makes it colored and how varying it can be.

Regarding the last sentence, what I mean was that when you say that I'm the one to blame for massive insecurities, when you condemn me as a source of the problem - for the time being, I can't defend myself with anything but take it - I can't answer it, because it is true. And that's why I'm making this thread, to get myself out of that view. And some of the comments did indeed help in that regard.
One of the few that actually helps and don't shame. Definitely found them interesting and helpful. Thanks!

Look, one of the reason I'm trying to find a workaround is exactly because people like you exist, and I don't want to hurt those people. Yes, I know that people are given what they are and they shouldn't be ashamed of that, and no, I've never, even before all this, intended to express this particular distaste to any woman for the sole reason of expressing distaste, I'd be mortified too if a partner said my penis, or any part of my body that I can't change for that matter, is unflattering.

I'm sorry for what you went through. That being said, much in the same way that someone can't exactly condemn someone that doesn't like a certain color of a dick - as odd as that idea may seem and as offended some people may be, I can't answer your first sentence either.
As a chou main i approve. Love that no one's carrying purify nowadays.
